## Location

Link the page, heading, API, ADR, or release note.

## Issue

Explain what is missing, outdated, ambiguous, or inconsistent.

## Suggested improvement

Provide proposed wording, references, diagrams, or examples when possible.

## Checklist

- [ ] I checked the README and `docs/project/` index.
- [ ] Any proposed links are relative and valid.
- [ ] The change does not alter implementation or API behavior.
